images.filename: AvBequerel.jpg
images.caption: En esta foto, vemos a la banda Alta Vibración en acción cuando eran un power trío, tocando en el Colegio Becquerel en Quito. A la derecha, Stefan Lauer está tocando una guitarra eléctrica con gran concentración. Viste una sudadera con capucha y jeans. A su lado, el bajista Mateo Rojos, amigo de la infancia de Stefan, toca el bajo eléctrico, mirando hacia el frente con seriedad. Aunque no se ve en la imagen, Josué Arauz era el encargado de la percusión. Están tocando en un espacio al aire libre, con una atmósfera casual y relajada.

images.filename: Iglesia de La Compañía, Quito, Ecuador, 2015-07-22, DD 149-151 HDR.JPG
images.caption: Main nave of the Church of the Society of Jesus (La Iglesia de la Compañía de Jesús), a Jesuit church in Quito, Ecuador. The exterior doesn't give an idea of the beauty of the interior, with a large central nave, which is profusely decorated with gold leaf, gilded plaster and wood carvings, making of it the most ornate church in Quito. The temple is one of the most significant works of Spanish Baroque architecture in America and considered the most beautiful church in Ecuador.
images.alt: Main nave of the Church of the Society of Jesus (La Iglesia de la Compañía de Jesús), a Jesuit church in Quito, Ecuador. images.caption: Exterior view of the church and Monastery of St. Francis, Quito, Ecuador. Construction took 150 years, and the church exhibits a mixture of different architecture styles.

images.filename: Iglesia de Santo Domingo, Quito, Ecuador, 2015-07-22, DD 202-204 HDR.JPG
images.caption: Main reredos of the Chapel of the Rosary in St Domingo church in the Historic Center of Quito, Ecuador. The catholic temple was constructed between 1540 and 1688 following the plans of architect Francisco Becerra. The baroque chapel, dedicated to Our Lady of the Rosary, is the most featurable in the church and was painted by priest Pedro Bedón at the beginning of the 17th century.
